name: Sphenosuchus
sum: Sphenosuchus is an Early Jurassic crocodylomorph from the Elliot Formation of South Africa, known mainly from a very well preserved skull.
wsnote: Estimated total length 1.4 m, with a 192 mm skull (Wikipedia).
holotype: A nearly perfect but slightly crushed skull with a shoulder girdle and a few limb bones; named by Haughton in 1915; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: A skull, shoulder girdle, forelimb elements and isolated parts of the hind limb.
biology: Probably quadrupedal but possibly a facultative biped; most known features come from the skull.
author: Haughton 1915

sources.text: S. H. Haughton. 1915. A new thecodont from the Stormberg beds. Annals of the South African Museum 12:98-105
